lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
recommendations-dashboard: 514 B beyond the first copy, generated by rollup 197 B, generated by vite 187 B, generated by typescript 79 B.
recommendations-main: 91 B beyond the first copy, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 68 B, generated by rollup 23 B.
30,173 B in 201 pieces of 3 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (28 packages, 124 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in build is left without something that loads it.
